Inici.speaker: Villager 4
Inici.text: Monsters… They became monsters… They were the ones supposed to save us…

Diàleg 1: vaca.speaker: Rose
Diàleg 1: vaca.text: What do you mean, the dragon is still near

Diàleg 1: vaca.speaker: Paca
Diàleg 1: vaca.text: I haven’t been chosen yet, and if I am, well… I hope I’m the tastiest of them all!

Diàleg 2: porc.speaker: Pep
Diàleg 2: porc.text: Which maiden shall be next? Not that I care.

Diàleg 2: porc.speaker: Rose
Diàleg 2: porc.text: What do you mean you don’t care?

Diàleg 2: porc.speaker: Pep
Diàleg 2: porc.text: Do you see me as a maiden? My name won’t be chosen. I won’t be eaten hahaha.

Diàleg 2: porc.speaker: Rose
Diàleg 2: porc.text: Yet lots of maidens will die. What will you do when there’s no one left?

Diàleg 2: porc.speaker: Pep
Diàleg 2: porc.text: Our king will think of something again when the time comes. It’s not my problem

Diàleg 3: ovella.speaker: BeEa
Diàleg 3: ovella.text: There’s nothing I can do if I’m next?

Diàleg 3: ovella.speaker: Rose
Diàleg 3: ovella.text: Don’t you want to fight it?

Diàleg 4: Colom.speaker: Colomet
Diàleg 4: Colom.text: There are no letters for me to deliver, I can walk in peace.

text.speaker: Rose
text.text: What will you live off now then

Diàleg suelta 2.speaker: Villager
Diàleg suelta 2.text: They say no one has seen the princess since the sacrifice of the queen

Diàleg suelta 4.speaker: Villager
Diàleg suelta 4.text: I like your coat. I see, so I can make one with a blanket…

Diàleg suelta 5.speaker: Villager
Diàleg suelta 5.text: Be careful with the sickle! You are gonna kill somebody!

Diàleg suelta 6.speaker: Villager
Diàleg suelta 6.text: Last full moon the dragon made a fuzz…

Diàleg suelta 6.speaker: Villager
Diàleg suelta 6.text: The maiden must have tasted horrible because he ate half of our harvest.

Quan la Rose arriba al bosc 1.speaker: Rose
Quan la Rose arriba al bosc 1.text: There’s no saving to these people…
